_comment: G3-BAND2 reopen: play S06. Run-local freeze record, written BEFORE the segment ran and never amended after. This exists because operator_harness.gd::_freeze_display_claim reads the run directory's own RUN_METADATA.json first and ralph/reports/gate-f-candidate/RUN_METADATA.json second; the global one is the 2026-08-27 freeze and carries a flat display_server of X11 under xvfb-run with no `lanes` block, which CD-8b-refuses this segment's headless logic lane before step 1 even though it plans zero captures of its own (they are delegated to S06C). Shape copied from the precedent this same defect already has -- ralph/reports/gate-f-capstone-1/RUN_METADATA.json's own `lanes` block, written for the identical reason.
